name: Yuma Pipeline Project

values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)

researcher_notes: LED Enterprises, LLC filed a request to start FERC pre-filing review for the planned Yuma Pipeline Project in docket PF25-8-000. FERC staff approved entry on April 2, 2025, and the docket opened March 19, 2025. A Federal Register scoping notice from September 24, 2026 states 138 miles of 30-inch pipeline, two meter stations and 10 mainline valves in Maricopa and Yuma counties, Arizona, carrying about 800 million cubic feet per day, mainly for northwest Mexico and the Yuma area. FERC says the project has not been approved. Both sources are FERC documents, so they count as one origin. Not confirmed from a source I could read: the in-service date of mid-2029, the El Paso interconnect, the exact border crossing near San Luis, and cost. Those are left blank. The record is not the same as the cancelled Ehrenberg to San Luis Rio Colorado line recorded earlier, which is a different, older project. Start and end are given at county level only. Operator name checked: no close match in the gas owner list; styled as LED Enterprises LLC. Fuel is natural gas. Length is 138 mi, far over the 15.5 mi minimum. Route: no route found, FERC scoping notice appendix 2 has a general location map which was not digitized, so route type is not mapped but could be.
